evidence_axes.representability: Supplied bounded construction expresses the declared function; it does not establish learning.
evidence_axes.formal_guarantee: Explicit conditional theorem/exact proof with candidate-specific assumption discharge; process exit does not certify it.
evidence_axes.implementation_conformance: Executed source follows its declared equations, state/custody and numerical admission.
evidence_axes.learned_capability: Experience causes useful persistent generalization under frozen task/controls; supplied structure remains disclosed.
evidence_axes.measured_utility: A predeclared useful effect at counted information/resources; no task-independent efficiency conclusion.
evidence_axes.integrated_capability: Required functions coexist in the same continuing versioned candidate.

result_contract.probe_status: One of statuses for the actually executed named local task; always display scope and coverage.
result_contract.criterion_status: A bounded_slice PASS leaves the full criterion NOT_TESTED. A tested necessary-condition FAIL, ERROR or UNSUPPORTED may be carried to the criterion with its explicit scope; this is not a universal impossibility verdict. Full criterion PASS requires full_contract_ready and complete reviewed required evidence.
result_contract.unsupported_meaning: A defined test cannot run through the selected candidate's declared interface.
result_contract.error_meaning: Unexpected execution/custody/dependency/timeout failure; retain it rather than skip.
result_contract.reference_mode: A reference pass verifies the reference package only; it cannot satisfy candidate criteria or readiness.
result_contract.coverage_rule: All34 rows must appear, including null test_key rows. No denominator excludes unsupported, untested or error rows.
result_contract.same_candidate_rule: Every candidate result binds one adapter/rule/source identity. Reference or other-candidate results cannot be merged to close gaps.

criteria.title: sensory representation and invariance
criteria.small_local_task: Relabel/rotate inputs with transported ports; occlude inputs; compare nuisance changes with genuine object changes.
criteria.formal_boundary: Declared coordinate transformations preserve public meaning; missing observations are not zero targets.
criteria.falsifier: A transported nuisance change alters the semantic answer, or an absent observation is silently treated as a zero target.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: multisensory binding
criteria.small_local_task: Cross color/location assignments and audiovisual common/separate causes; pair-marginal shortcuts must fail.
criteria.formal_boundary: Retain joint identity, location and timing; compatible local readings need not have identical private states.
criteria.falsifier: Crossed attributes are confused, or pairwise-marginal controls give the same answers on cases requiring joint identity.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: uncertainty and ambiguity
criteria.small_local_task: Two equally plausible causes, noisy/conflicting cues and missing sensors; score calibration and proper predictive loss, not confidence alone.
criteria.formal_boundary: Preserve admissible alternatives; numerical residual is distinct from prediction error and uncertainty.
criteria.falsifier: The candidate collapses admissible alternatives or reports low solver residual as calibrated uncertainty despite failed predictive scoring.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: selective attention and active sensing
criteria.small_local_task: Query one of many competing items, then choose a costly additional observation; same-information lookup/attention and random-query controls.
criteria.formal_boundary: Selection variables and their feedback participate in the same equations; evidence cannot vanish through zeroed gains.
criteria.falsifier: Selection does not causally affect the joint interpretation, or the candidate makes difficult evidence disappear by collapsing gains.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: object permanence and latent context
criteria.small_local_task: Occlude and move an object; present identical final images after different histories; compare a memoryless controller.
criteria.formal_boundary: Current state is conditional on retained history, not solely the latest sensor vector.
criteria.falsifier: Opposite object histories with an identical current observation produce no appropriate history-dependent response.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: order, duration and asynchronous streams
criteria.small_local_task: AB versus BA, variable gaps, delayed sensors and replay of identical timed events with different solver budgets.
criteria.formal_boundary: Event time, causal order and repair time are separate; no use of future observations.
criteria.falsifier: AB and BA or distinct delays are indistinguishable where the task requires otherwise; outcomes depend on solver speed rather than event time, or future evidence leaks.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: ongoing temporal activity
criteria.small_local_task: A timed alternating action or rhythmic body with constant external drive; require the clock/phase source and cost to be explicit, with cadence invariant to solver speed.
criteria.formal_boundary: State explicitly whether equilibrium describes a moment, trajectory window or conditional interpretation; do not claim a nonconstant orbit is a static fixed point.
criteria.falsifier: The rhythm depends on numerical iteration speed or an undisclosed clock; a capped oscillatory solver is reported as a qualified static equilibrium.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: working memory
criteria.small_local_task: Delayed matching with distractors and ordered recall; vary capacity and delay, compare frozen/erased state.
criteria.formal_boundary: Bounded content survives distraction over a declared delay; update and read boundaries are defined.
criteria.falsifier: A declared remembered item is lost within the tested delay/distraction budget, or repeated queries rewrite its evidence.
criteria.scope: Bounded scalar history discrimination and read purity.
criteria.small_local_probe: Opposite three-event integer histories followed by the same final zero; repeated queries preserve retained evidence.

criteria.title: episodic, source and context memory
criteria.small_local_task: Recall similar encounters with different outcomes; reorder/duplicate records and insert imagined successes.
criteria.formal_boundary: Preserve witnessed versus imagined events, source, time and action identity.
criteria.falsifier: A duplicate, hypothetical or wrong-source event is admitted as fresh fact; continuation loses ownership or the declared event-order contract.
criteria.scope: Ownership and exactly-once behavior within one finite ordered-source contract.
not_discharged: Action/time/context identity outside this scalar protocol
criteria.small_local_probe: One ordered source: latest identical retry, conflicting retry, old/skipped ID, hypothetical event, serialization and continuation.

criteria.title: semantic and relational abstraction
criteria.small_local_task: Learn relations on some combinations, test held-out entities and reversed queries; retrieval and training-mean controls.
criteria.formal_boundary: Stored rules support previously unseen compositions rather than retrieving a matching record.
criteria.falsifier: Held-out relations/combinations cannot be answered beyond retrieval or training-mean controls under the same evidence budget.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: procedural learning and habits
criteria.small_local_task: Practice a body skill, freeze or erase learned state, change the body, then restore it.
criteria.formal_boundary: Persistent change must causally improve later action, with disclosed motor support.
criteria.falsifier: Practice does not improve executed skill relative to frozen memory, or restoring/erasing learned state does not restore/remove the improvement.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: consolidation, recall and forgetting
criteria.small_local_task: Common irrelevant events versus a rare consequential lesson; spaced versus massed exposure; score retention and interference at equal storage/work.
criteria.formal_boundary: Finite memory has an explicit retention/overwrite mechanism; recall does not fabricate fresh evidence.
criteria.falsifier: The required rare lesson is overwritten by irrelevant events at the stated capacity, or recall inflates evidence without a new witness.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: replay and offline reorganization
criteria.small_local_task: Equal-budget replay versus rest/no-replay; test held-out generalization and old-skill retention without outside labels during rest.
criteria.formal_boundary: Reused records remain reused evidence; no multiple independent counts or uncharged compute.
criteria.falsifier: A replay advantage disappears under equal work/storage, or recycled facts are counted as independent new observations.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: incidental and associative acquisition
criteria.small_local_task: Masked relation stream with before-outcome scoring; one-shot salient episodes and habituation/dishabituation; frozen-memory control.
criteria.formal_boundary: One admitted experience can revise durable relations through the declared rule; causal effects cannot be inferred from correlation alone.
criteria.falsifier: Witnessed experience produces no reusable prediction improvement over a frozen-memory control, or the alleged gain uses target leakage.
criteria.scope: Acquisition of parameters in a supplied scalar likelihood family.
criteria.small_local_probe: Compare before/after predictions after six +2 witnesses with frozen and restored-memory controls; final squared error must be less than one quarter of frozen-prior error.

criteria.title: learning from delayed consequences
criteria.small_local_task: Delayed reward with irrelevant intervening actions; shuffle eligibility/context and vary delay under a fixed storage budget.
criteria.formal_boundary: Credit uses only information available from the executed action and its later outcome.
criteria.falsifier: A delayed consequence changes an unrelated action record, or shuffled/erased eligibility performs identically where temporal credit is necessary.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: continual adaptation without catastrophic loss
criteria.small_local_task: A→B→A and interleaved incompatible contexts; measure absolute skill, forgetting and recovery, with equal-memory online controls.
criteria.formal_boundary: Separate acquisition, retention and reacquisition; no universal no-forgetting theorem under unlimited tasks and bounded storage.
criteria.falsifier: The candidate fails declared post-switch accuracy or loses old-context competence beyond the retention bound; later reacquisition is mislabeled retention.
criteria.scope: A necessary fast-switch response on one scalar A-B-A fixture.
criteria.small_local_probe: Four -2, four +2, four -2 observations without supplied context labels; score switch/return predictions and keep pooled/frozen controls.

criteria.title: causal world modelling
criteria.small_local_task: Matched observational correlations with different causal structures; intervene on the body/environment and predict consequences before seeing them.
criteria.formal_boundary: Distinguish conditioning from intervention and self-generated from external input.
criteria.falsifier: The learned model cannot distinguish conditioning from an intervention or predicts an outcome only after seeing it.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: adaptive operating range
criteria.small_local_task: Shift input scale and sustained excitation, then restore them; score saturation/silence, retained predictions and recovery, versus fixed-gain and frozen-memory controls.
criteria.formal_boundary: Keep useful activity and learning stable under chronic drive changes; normalization must not erase information or remove all constraints.
criteria.falsifier: Drive shifts cause persistent saturation/silence or erase relevant distinctions, or restored conditions fail the declared recovery/retention gate.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: innate competence and internal drives
criteria.small_local_task: Same odor with different energy state; actual eating restores energy; hunger competes with danger; lesion drive-to-choice influence.
criteria.formal_boundary: Initial structure and observed bodily needs are explicit; choice cannot be delegated to a food/avoidance script.
criteria.falsifier: Bodily need does not causally affect neural choice or intake does not alter sensed energy; an outside script supplies the selected food/action.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: emotion-like valuation and motivational context
criteria.small_local_task: Identical cue under danger, satiety or deprivation; test priorities, recovery and generalization beyond one cue.
criteria.formal_boundary: Operationalize valence, urgency and persistence as functional variables, without asserting felt emotion.
criteria.falsifier: Valuation/context interventions do not change priorities as declared, or a behavioral variable is promoted to evidence of subjective emotion.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: smooth embodied control
criteria.small_local_task: Moving target, force disturbance, actuator lag and wall/corner; measure tracking, collisions, latency and adaptation.
criteria.formal_boundary: Neural request, body-controller transform and actual action are separately observable; stability guarantees need explicit plant/delay assumptions.
criteria.falsifier: Tracking, collision, latency or actuator-adaptation thresholds fail, or body assistance chooses unreported goals or changes the intended action.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: exploration and exploitation
criteria.small_local_task: A changing small bandit/body-identification task with costly probing; random exploration and conventional online controls.
criteria.formal_boundary: Information-seeking and uncertainty must affect decisions without future reward access.
criteria.falsifier: Exploration uses inaccessible future rewards or fails the declared information-versus-cost comparison with competent controls.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: goal-directed planning and flexibility
criteria.small_local_task: Detours, prerequisites, changed outcomes/rewards and novel start-goal pairs; vary horizon independently of observer depth. Reactive/habit and same-world-model planning controls.
criteria.formal_boundary: Compare possible action sequences against goals, constraints and uncertainty before acting; predicted outcomes are not witnessed events. External search and compute are charged.
criteria.falsifier: Changed goals/constraints invalidate plans, search uses hidden simulator answers, or a horizon/work-matched reactive control explains the result.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: composed agreement at multiple scales
criteria.small_local_task: Monolithic versus nested federation solutions, gauge relabeling, outside intervention and deliberately lossy summaries.
criteria.formal_boundary: Consistency/observation preservation and conditional normalizer naturality; retain necessary joint boundary information.
criteria.falsifier: Regrouping or a permitted outside intervention changes the declared boundary response, or coarse marginals lose a necessary joint correlation.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: recursive self-observation
criteria.small_local_task: Perturb an observer, trace lower-state changes and returned effects on the observer; compare frozen/sequential and degree-matched controls.
criteria.formal_boundary: Observers and observed variables remain jointly live; reciprocal influence must enter the actual equations.
criteria.falsifier: An observer reads frozen/external diagnostics rather than current beliefs, or either direction of its declared feedback is causally absent.
criteria.scope: Live uncertainty readback and reciprocal influence in one supplied scalar model.
criteria.small_local_probe: Perturb actual lower uncertainty and observer precision in turn, inspect reciprocal proposals, repair, and cut readback/feedback under the intact equations.

criteria.title: error monitoring and calibrated self-assessment
criteria.small_local_task: Change cue reliability; permit abstention or request help; compare an ordinary same-information recurrent predictor.
criteria.formal_boundary: Internal confidence must predict future errors under intervention, not merely correlate with solver steps or output magnitude.
criteria.falsifier: Confidence/abstention fails calibrated error prediction under reliability interventions or only tracks solver activity without predictive value.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: rule abstraction and flexible reasoning
criteria.small_local_task: Relational puzzles with withheld compositions, distractors, missing premises and changed surface labels; vary dependency length independently of observer depth. Exact oracle plus lookup/attention/recurrent controls.
criteria.formal_boundary: Derive consequences from declared facts, rules and hypotheses; distinguish entailed, contradicted and undetermined conclusions. Test compositional generalization independently of seen templates.
criteria.falsifier: The candidate confuses entailment, contradiction and underdetermination or fails withheld rule compositions while succeeding on memorized templates.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: social inference, imitation and communication
criteria.small_local_task: Two-agent hidden-information coordination and false-belief-style tasks; imitation transfer to a changed body.
criteria.formal_boundary: Other agents have distinct access and beliefs; tasks must exclude privileged-state leakage.
criteria.falsifier: Coordination requires privileged access to another agent's hidden state or does not transfer under the declared information/body change.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: language and symbolic composition
criteria.small_local_task: Grounded instruction following on unseen combinations and limited dialogue history; compare grammar/template and online language controls.
criteria.formal_boundary: Define grounded generalization targets; benchmark success alone does not identify a human language mechanism.
criteria.falsifier: Grounded instruction performance fails withheld combinations, or a template/retrieval control accounts for the result at matched information.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: imagination and counterfactual construction
criteria.small_local_task: Predict an unexecuted action's consequences, reconstruct an occluded scene and compose an unseen combination; score against held-out outcomes/constraints. No outcome access during construction; memory-only and shuffled-model controls.
criteria.formal_boundary: Internally complete or recombine a possible situation under explicit assumptions, including absent sensory content and unexecuted actions. Hypothetical and witnessed state remain distinguishable within the joint model.
criteria.falsifier: Imagined branches fabricate factual evidence, access unobserved outcomes, or fail held-out consequences/combinations beyond memory-only controls.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: development and structural adaptation
criteria.small_local_task: Add/remove capacity under task change; compare fixed wider, random growth and evolved wiring with all search cost counted.
criteria.formal_boundary: Wiring changes preserve typed interfaces, state custody and the applicable qualification contract.
criteria.falsifier: Growth/pruning corrupts ports, memory or qualification, or costs/selection privilege make an apparent gain uninterpretable.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

criteria.title: robustness and functional recovery
criteria.small_local_task: Missing/noisy neurons or ports, localized lesions, delayed messages and gradual body change; score degradation and relearning.
criteria.formal_boundary: Faults have explicit scope; independent patch correctness does not prove arbitrary composition correct.
criteria.falsifier: A specified fault corrupts durable state or cannot meet the declared degradation/recovery limit; passing isolated patches is substituted for composition testing.
criteria.scope: Transactional recovery from a numerical cap.
criteria.small_local_probe: Force a zero-budget admission failure; preserve persistent bytes/cursor, then retry the same event once with a sufficient unchanged budget.

criteria.title: bounded resources and graceful overload
criteria.small_local_task: Increase sensor rate and number of objects at fixed compute/memory; p99 latency, stale actions, dropped evidence and recovery.
criteria.formal_boundary: Bounded queues/storage, coherent evidence versions and declared service/fallback behavior.
criteria.falsifier: The candidate exceeds fixed storage/deadline bounds, silently drops evidence or executes stale commands under the declared overload.
criteria.scope: Finite storage/capacity and bounded local execution for the scalar fixture.
criteria.small_local_probe: Fill the declared finite witness capacity, check bounded serialized state and per-case deadline, reject overflow without mutation.

criteria.title: integrated competence
criteria.small_local_task: Interleave perception, delayed learning, recall, bodily needs and action; compare each isolated score to the combined stream.
criteria.formal_boundary: The same frozen rule and persistent brain must retain multiple functions together.
criteria.falsifier: Combining previously passed functions in the same persistent candidate breaks any required score or secretly switches to another primitive.
criteria.scope: Catalogue task not implemented by this battery; thresholds and candidate interface must be frozen before execution.

readiness_gates.title: one primitive
readiness_gates.requirement: One executed local repair law computes both responses and retained change; all compiler rules, priors and genes are declared.
required_artifacts: Source audit of inference and learning execution

readiness_gates.title: joint repair and federation
readiness_gates.requirement: Whole-system qualification, actual schedule/topology assumptions and preserved joint boundaries.
required_artifacts: Model-specific theorem or exact bounded proof

readiness_gates.title: owned experience and continuation
readiness_gates.requirement: Exactly-once accepted commits within a stated horizon, isolated imagination, rejection rollback and complete continuation.

readiness_gates.title: learned capabilities in the same candidate
readiness_gates.requirement: All34 required bounded capability contracts and evidence axes are discharged for one selected version.

readiness_gates.title: integrated continuing operation
readiness_gates.requirement: One persistent candidate combines the required functions and preserves previous skill at declared cost.

readiness_gates.title: numerical and resource reliability
readiness_gates.requirement: Explicit finite/admission/approximation/error handling and bounded work, storage, deadlines and overload.

readiness_gates.title: retire current contracts deliberately
readiness_gates.requirement: Every required old API/use case has a tested replacement or explicit conversion/loading policy; surviving required legacy primitive means partial replacement.

readiness_gates.title: production and independent review
readiness_gates.requirement: Public package, supported platforms/backends, tutorials and failure contracts have independent release coverage.

challenge_fixtures.title: Directed fly transition fixture
challenge_fixtures.candidate_task: Solve the frozen tiny transition-factor model built from declared signed directed fly influences and compare its joint probabilities/readouts with an independent exact oracle.
challenge_fixtures.falsifier: Candidate disagrees with the transformed model or silently claims it preserves the original continuous recurrent dynamics.
challenge_fixtures.scope: A discrete transition model is an explicit adapter/model change, not whole-fly biology or rate-equation equivalence.

challenge_fixtures.title: Inconsistent loop and holonomy
challenge_fixtures.candidate_task: Represent a frozen contradictory binary cycle; distinguish an accurately solved frustrated model from impossible satisfaction of every parity relation.
challenge_fixtures.falsifier: Zero local/message residual is reported as all original constraints satisfied, or a chosen cut/model change is hidden.
challenge_fixtures.scope: Finite semantic-conflict test; not unrestricted loopy convergence or useful learning.

challenge_fixtures.title: Correlation-preserving federation boundary
challenge_fixtures.candidate_task: Compare monolithic and nested exact bounded models under an outside intervention; include equal marginals with different joint correlations.
challenge_fixtures.falsifier: A boundary loses a relevant correlation or changes the declared external conditional response.
challenge_fixtures.scope: Fixed finite compositional oracle; no learned interface or scalable arbitrary federation claim.

challenge_fixtures.title: Transported relabeling
challenge_fixtures.candidate_task: Transport variables, factors and ports together under fixed relabelings; verify the corresponding observable result is unchanged.
challenge_fixtures.falsifier: A correctly transported representation changes observable probabilities, or only labels are moved while factors/ports remain fixed.
challenge_fixtures.scope: Existing finite reference only until a candidate-specific transport interface is implemented.

challenge_fixtures.title: Preserved self-observation reference
challenge_fixtures.candidate_task: Read-only verification of the existing Gaussian/Gamma readback package and its explicit perturbation traces.
challenge_fixtures.falsifier: Source/result verification fails or a separate candidate's result is attributed to the selected candidate.
challenge_fixtures.scope: Historical reference candidate only; not selected-candidate O2 or R1 evidence.

challenge_fixtures.title: Preserved game and C64 arithmetic
challenge_fixtures.candidate_task: Read-only verification of the existing small1942/C64/Atari arithmetic receipt when its local source inputs exist.
challenge_fixtures.falsifier: Source/receipt arithmetic mismatches, or saved prior-game results are promoted to new-candidate gameplay.
challenge_fixtures.scope: No gameplay, training, checkpoint reconstruction or capability transfer; missing local evidence remains NOT_TESTED.

requirements: All34 full bounded contracts frozen and reviewed
All required evidence axes discharged for that candidate
R1-R8 reviewed PASS with linked artifacts
core_readiness.current_blocker: Every criterion currently has full_contract_ready=false; a collection of partial probe passes cannot discharge the unchanged34-capability pre-scale gate.
